prompt: Camera holds still at eye level. Straight away the dealer, holding the framed gavel picture in his left hand, lifts his open right hand and both shoulders in a slow shrug, tilts his head, and says in a dry English accent: "The courts. Slightly used." His mouth matches each word, said once and plainly, with a little half-smile at the end. The card tag hanging from the frame keeps its handwritten "THE COURTS - SLIGHTLY USED" exactly as written. The red-brick picture in the crate in front stays where it is. Light rain falls beyond the white gazebo; people in the background drift slowly between stalls. Sound: his single line, rain on the gazebo roof, a low crowd murmur. Overcast natural light.
